BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (no EPS change in FY14-FY23 ex-FY15 ex-FY17 ex-FY19 ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22 to measure: the 0% cap); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +3.6%/yr (Q1 sales ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY15 ex-FY17 ex-FY19 ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22 median

BULL.desc: EPS +13.9%/yr (FY14-FY23 ex-FY15 ex-FY17 ex-FY19 ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +48.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY14-FY23 ex-FY15 ex-FY17 ex-FY19 ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: BMY (retrospective, 2024-06-14) ◉ BUY — Ratio B -0.12x (-23.8% downside to Bear $51 / +191.3% upside to Bull $120) | Adj composite 2.25 vs market 1.10: gap +1.15 [UNDERVALUED] | -33% above the EPP floor $62 (16x FY24E $3.86) | Conservative 2-yr case: +95.8% total (+47.9%/yr) | At 10.7x FY24E the 15% hurdle price $54 sits at or below the BASE case; U.S. revenues +6.6% in Q1 2024, forward revenues +6% (no FY24 revenue guide in numbers, Q1 2024 net sales growth ex-FX); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
